_readme: Demo questions with hand-derived expectations. 'expect_paths' = exact node-id sequences that must appear among the traversed paths (each hand-checked against data/synthetic/ground_truth_graph.json edges; scripts/run_examples.py re-verifies that too). 'forbid_nodes' = ids that must NOT appear in any path starting from an entity named in the question (guards against wrong-but-plausible traces). 'expect_docs' = source doc_ids that must appear in the retrieved text evidence.

questions.question: Which CAPAs trace back to 21 CFR 211.68(a)?
What is going on with DEV-2026-031?
questions.expected_answer: Calibration-overdue deviation on Tablet Press TP-03 (EQP-0001); addressed by CAPA-2026-011 (CAP-0001); relates to 21 CFR 211.68(a) and 211.100(b).

questions.question: What is going on with DEV-2026-047?
questions.hops: Deviation -> Equipment / <- CAPA / -> RegulationClause / <- Inspector -> RegulationClause
questions.expected_answer: Audit-trail-review deviation on HPLC-02 (EQP-0002); addressed by CAPA-2026-019 (CAP-0002); relates to EU GMP Annex 11 cl. 9 and 21 CFR 211.160; raised by inspector Dana Whitfield.

questions.question: Tell me about equipment TP-03
questions.hops: Equipment <- Deviation <- CAPA; Equipment -> Site; Equipment -> SOP
questions.expected_answer: Tablet Press TP-03 (EQP-0001): deviation DEV-2026-031 and its CAPA-2026-011; located at Riverbend Solid Dose Facility; covered by the calibration SOP.

questions.question: Which CAPAs trace back to EU GMP Annex 11, clause 9?
Which SOP does CAPA-2026-019 revise, and which regulation clause does that SOP implement?
questions.expected_answer: CAPA-2026-019 revises the audit-trail review SOP (SOP-0003), which implements EU GMP Annex 11 clause 9.

questions.question: Which CAPAs are linked to equipment HPLC-02?
Which inspector raised DEV-2026-047 and which clauses did they cite?
questions.expected_answer: Inspector Dana Whitfield (INS-0001) raised it and cited EU GMP Annex 11 clause 9 and 21 CFR 211.160.

questions.question: Which deviations were observed in Lot MX26-014 and which CAPAs addressed them?
questions.expected_answer: Two deviations were observed in Lot MX26-014: DEV-2026-031 (CAPA-2026-011) and DEV-2026-047 (CAPA-2026-019).
